pages.content:
# SPEC-89 HTTP privacy

Status: APPROVED

MUST
- Requirement-ID: SPEC-89:R1
- Requirement: Redact Cookie headers before logging.
- Issue title: [SPEC-89:R1] Redact Cookie header
- Gap text: Cookie header is logged
- Code path: src/http_log.ts

MUST
- Requirement-ID: SPEC-89:R2
- Requirement: Redact Authorization headers before logging.
- Issue title: [SPEC-89:R2] Redact Authorization header
- Gap text: Authorization header is logged
- Code path: src/http_log.ts
